deny.comment: refuses --upl* (abbreviated --upload-pack) on git -C fetch; known over-match: the mid * can absorb the verb, so a git -C commit message holding ' log --outp', ' diff --outp' or ' fetch --upl' is refused (reword it); --outp* also refuses --output-indicator-*
